AUTHOR: Carletti
TITLE: Joint underwater image enhancement and multi-scale fish detection
DATA: DeepFish (Muksit et al. 2022 annotated subset), OzFish, Fish4Knowledge (Roboflow), own MiviaFish train/test; Muksit test set (DeepFish+OzFish)
V_EV: Sec. 4.1.1: 'inclusion of samples captured under low-light conditions. For instance, it contains dark images illuminated by external light sources'
D2: train/val ~80/20 (13,207/3,040 images); separate Muksit test (1,261) and MiviaFish test (427)
D_EV: Sec. 4.1.2: 'all images within the test set are not included in the training and in the validation sets, as well as the scenarios, ensuring an unbiased assessment'
R_EV: Sec. 4.1: test sets drawn from DeepFish/OzFish and MiviaFish, all of which are also used for training: 'samples were selected from four different datasets'
C_EV: Sec. 4.2.1: 'Additional parameters, such as a confidence threshold of 0.15 and an IoU threshold of 0.6, were uniformly applied'
E_EV: Sec. 4.3/4.6: 'MAE = |True Count − Predicted Count|'; 'YOLO-JUICE achieves the best MAE ... (0.87 vs. 1.32)' on MiviaFish test set
ARCH: YOLO-JUICE: YOLOv8s + P2 layer, SPD conv, CBAM + jointly fine-tuned FUnIE-GAN enhancement
METR: P, R, F1, AP50, AP50:95, mIoU, count MAE/SD, per size class
NOTE: Headline tests: Muksit test set (DeepFish+OzFish, scenarios excluded from training -> coded site/habitat split) and MiviaFish test set (new, 'collected', but MiviaFish training set from same source also used in training -> not external per P2).
